subject: Resilience onboarding / SLA elevation – FinWay renewal path
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@finway.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@finway.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in tail latency affecting production - impact to renewal

Tessa —

Quick note from our SREs: since Feb 25 we've seen repeated tail-latency spikes during peak transaction windows (18:00-20:00 PST). Average P95 is within expected range, but P99/P999 occasionally jumps by 3-6x for 30–90s bursts. These correlate with user-facing errors in our payment routing service (about ~0.4% error-rate increase).

We raised an incident on Feb 27 (attached timeline) and the team ran mitigations, but the patterns have recurred twice this week. Our renewal with Redwood is up April 15 and we need clarity on:
- whether this is an infrastructure/config issue on our side or a platform-level SLO variance;
- options for higher-assurance coverage (short-term credits vs. Premium SLA / Dedicated pilot);
- timeline for remediation steps if we pursue an elevated SLA.

This is causing internal pressure from procurement/ops — Jenna is looped. Can we get a short-read on remediation options and a commercial path for a reliability uplift?

Thanks,
Samir
Platform & SRE Lead
FinWay

Attachments: FinWay_incident_timeline_Mar2027.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@finway.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in tail latency affecting production - impact to renewal

Samir —

Thanks for the clear summary and the incident timeline. I'm sorry to hear you're seeing those bursts — we take tail-latency regressions seriously. High level next steps I propose:

1) Triage: our infra team (cc'ed) will correlate your incident timeline with platform telemetry. Can you confirm the request IDs or sample trace IDs for the two latest events? That helps us map to kernel/GC/IO events.

2) Short-term relief: offer a 2-week Dedicated warm-pool pilot scoped to the payment-routing endpoints (isolated pool, fixed instance classes, KV-prefetching). This is a common mitigation for bursty tails and buys stability while we diagnose root cause.

3) Commercial/contract: we can surface two paths — (A) one-time service credit tied to documented impact; (B) upgrade to Premium SLA with regional redundancy and an SLA amendment (this includes a resilience playbook and faster incident escalation SLOs). I'll ask sales to draft both options and cost deltas.

4) Timeline: propose a 30‑minute sync Friday 3/12 at 10am PT to review telemetry and scope the pilot. If that works, I'll also attach our latest SLO snapshot and a starter mutual action plan.

I attached an SLO snapshot and a short rundown of the "Resilience Onboard" playbook we use for pilots. If you can share the trace IDs before Friday, we can be more precise in our recommendations.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0132

Attachments: redwood_slo_snapshot_Q1_2027.pdf, mutual_action_plan_finway_dedicated_pilot.xlsx

From: Samir Rao <samir@finway.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@redwood.com>, ops@finway.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in tail latency affecting production - impact to renewal

Tessa —

Friday 3/12 10am PT works. I'm attaching the trace samples and the internal incident notes. Quick clarifications:
- Renewal timeline: we have a conditional renewal window — procurement will sign if we get clear mitigation and a commitable uplift path by end of March.
- Commercial ask: procurement expects to see the cost delta for Premium SLA vs current plan, plus any pilot credit for the Dedicated warm pool.

I've attached the trace IDs in the PDF. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

—Samir

Attachments: FinWay_incident_traces_Mar2027.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Spike in tail latency affecting production - impact to renewal

Team —

Fwd'ing FinWay thread. They have trace samples and a renewal decision tied to reliability mitigations. Please action:
- Neha: can you prepare commercial options (one-time credit, Premium SLA uplift, Dedicated warm-pool pilot + pilot pricing and any standard discount schedules)? Procurement wants a succinct comparison table.
- Vivek: infra triage requested — match their trace IDs to platform telemetry and confirm whether this pattern is a model-serving tail (KV miss, batching spike, or host IO). If we recommend Dedicated pilot, outline the pilot scope (duration, instance shape, performance guardrails).
- Marcus: product/ops — we may need an addendum and an expedited runbook for the pilot plus an acceptance criteria doc.

FinWay's procurement needs a reply by EOD next Tuesday (3/16). I've scheduled the 3/12 sync to gather telemetry context.

Thanks,
Tessa

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@finway.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 12:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in tail latency affecting production - impact to renewal (Commercial options)

Hi Samir, Tessa —

Following our sync this morning, here's a concise set of commercial options you can present to procurement:

Option 1 — Goodwill credit (no SLA change)
- One-time credit equivalent to 2 months of platform fees tied to incident evidence.
- No change to contract terms; standard support.

Option 2 — Dedicated Pilot + Pilot Credit
- 2-week Dedicated warm-pool pilot scoped to payment-routing services. Pilot credit: 50% off pilot consumption up to a ceiling ($12k credit).
- Post-pilot: if both parties agree pilot reduced tail-latency by target metric, customer can convert to a 12-month Dedicated commitment with customary volume discount.

Option 3 — Premium SLA Amendment
- Upgrade to Premium SLA (regional redundancy + 99.95% availability target and tightened incident response SLOs).
- Commercial delta: ~+18% ARR on current plan; we can offer a 10% upfront term discount for 12-month commitment.

Notes and links:
- Technical scope and acceptance criteria attached in the mutual action plan.
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/finway (internal)
- DocuSign addendum template will be shared once option selected.

If you want, we can draft a short addendum for Option 2 or Option 3 and circulate for fast-track signature.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_finway_dedicated_pilot.xlsx

From: Samir Rao <samir@finway.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@redwood.com>, ops@finway.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in tail latency affecting production - impact to renewal

Team —

Thanks for the options and for the pilot plan. Procurement and ops have reviewed and we want to proceed with Option 2 (Dedicated Pilot + Pilot Credit). Two asks before we sign the pilot addendum:
1) Please scope the pilot acceptance criteria into the addendum (we want measurable P99 reduction targets and no-regression on throughput).
2) Provide the DocuSign link and timeline for stand-up (we'd like the pilot to start by 3/22).

If those two are included, procurement will fast-track the addendum and we will proceed with a 12-month Dedicated conversion if pilot targets are met.

I'll expect the DocuSign link and pilot scope doc by EOD Wednesday (3/17).

Samir Rao
Platform & SRE Lead, FinWay
